rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that happened a short while ago.

example.english: The recent news is quite interesting.
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 ge3 san1 man4 gei2 jau5 ceoi3

rows.note: Use this for a conversational “in the recent period” framing, especially for events or developments.

example.english: Housing prices have risen quickly in recent times.
example.jyutping: gan6 paai4 ge3 lau4 gaa3 sing1 dak1 hou2 faai3

rows.note: Use this for something up-to-date or the latest rather than something merely recent in time.

example.english: The recent phone model has come out.
example.jyutping: zeoi3 san1 ge3 sau2 gei1 ceot1 zo2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a modern-style thing that is not old-fashioned or dated.

example.english: This recent modern-style air conditioner saves much more electricity.
example.traditional: 呢部新式嘅冷氣機慳電好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 san1 sik1 ge3 laang5 hei3 gei1 haan1 din6 hou2 do1
